scripts.llama: cd cpp_modules/llama && pwd && mkdir -p build && cd build && ccmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DLLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=`pwd`/../dist .. && make -f Makefile all && make install
scripts.build: make -j 3 -f Makefile all && cd test && pwd && mkdir -p build/src && ls -lastr ${MODULE_DIRECTORY}/ && make  -j 3 -f Makefile all
scripts.test: cnpm build && cd test && pwd && ./test --test-case='test metaphrasing csl-data.json schema to gbnf'
